summary: Describes the NEA Asokan Attack, a subtle forwarding attack against Network Endpoint Assessment protocols, which check the health of devices joining a network. It explains how the attack works and what countermeasures can be used. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A sneaky person walks up to the door wearing a healthy friend's wristband instead of showing their own. This explains the trick and how guards can stop it.

questions: what is the nea asokan attack
how to protect network endpoint assessment from forwarding attacks
